facts.value: Inert unless DbLevel == DbLKind_Develop. Held B plus newly pressed D-pad Up toggles the effect allocator through b0; independently held A plus newly pressed Up toggles generator, particle and PSAppSrt allocators through b1. With both A and B held, both groups toggle, B first. Zero latches snapshot each allocator's own peak and enable; set latches disable enforcement without clearing numeric limits. No player-0 guard or local bounds check exists. The inspected caller invokes this for players 0..3, so multiple matching players can toggle shared state back in one caller pass. Setup or external allocator changes can desynchronize latches and enforcement.
facts.rationale: Correct or narrow inherited claim with pinned canonical source and saved existing-object observations.

facts.value: Implements a DEVELOP-mode allocation stress control that caps selected effect and particle-related allocators at their historical peak live-object counts. It can disable those ceilings again. Freeing and reallocating below the ceiling remain possible; current populations and reserved heap storage are not frozen.
facts.rationale: The limiter fixes a ceiling, not a population: used can fall on free and rise again below the historical peak.
